name: Tokyo 0 Ku Sadistic Mary
source:
Tokyo Zero Ward is commonly known as Lost Area. Mary is a female bandit who inhabits this shady area, rides a bike and targets only bad people for crimes. However, once she assaults a senior government car and gets fiercely targeted herself.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
东京零号区通常被称为失落之地。玛丽是一名居住在这片阴暗地区的女匪徒，她骑着摩托车，只对坏人实施犯罪。然而，她袭击了一辆政府高官的座车后，自己也遭到了猛烈追捕。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
